05_player_reference/00_start_here.html.title: 00_Start_Here
05_player_reference/00_start_here.html.description:
Welcome to a world where Gates are real, monsters exist, and the government insists everything is under control.You are a Hunter — one of the few people capable of surviving inside a Gate.This page will help you understand: The world as the public sees it What Hunters are How Gates work (as far as anyone knows) What your character would reasonably know in June 2025 For deeper details, see: World_Overview_Player
Hunters_101 Strange spatial distortions called Gates have appeared sporadically since 2023. The Department of Homeland Security classifies them as Anomalous Containment Events. Official statements claim they are contained natural phenomena. Social media claims otherwise. The government denies monsters exist. Leaked footage says they do. Most people: Avoid Gate sites. Trust federal containment teams. Think conspiracy forums exaggerate the truth. You know: Gates are real. Creatures inside them are deadly. Not everyone can enter safely. Something about you changed. Whether you awakened recently or have been active for months, you are now part of a quiet, dangerous ecosystem operating beneath public awareness.This is: Modern-day (June 2025) Set primarily in Chicago Government-controlled secrecy Slow escalation Long-term progression This is not full apocalypse.This is controlled instability.Unless discovered in play, your character does NOT automatically know: The true origin of Gates Whether they are natural or artificial If something is causing them Any classified federal doctrine If you want your character to have deeper knowledge, talk to the GM.This world is layered.The truth is not evenly distributed.And what you believe may not be the whole story.

headers.heading: What You Do Not Automatically Know

05_player_reference/gates_101.html.title: Gates_101
05_player_reference/gates_101.html.description:
A Gate is a localized spatial anomaly that connects our world to a contained, unstable environment.They appear as:
Distorted air or light
Shimmering thresholds
Fractured geometry
Collapsed spaces that are “bigger on the inside”
Once formed, a Gate remains active until:
Its internal ecosystem is neutralized, or
It collapses naturally.
No one publicly understands why they appear.Each Gate contains:
Hostile organisms
Environmental hazards
Altered physics conditions
Unstable terrain
Occasionally structured spaces (ruins, caverns, forests, etc.)
Time perception is usually normal.Technology works — but not always reliably.Electronics may:
Glitch
Lose signal
Experience interference
Higher-threat Gates tend to show stronger environmental distortion.Hunters use informal rankings to assess danger:
E Rank – Minor threat, small creature clusters
D Rank – Manageable team-level danger
C Rank – Professional hazard level
B Rank – High lethality without coordination
A Rank – Severe threat environment
S Rank – Catastrophic risk
These rankings are based on:
Observed creature strength
Environmental instability
Required team capability
The government does not officially recognize this system.Hunters do.When the internal “core” or primary threat is neutralized:
The environment destabilizes.
The Gate entrance begins to shrink.
A collapse window begins (usually minutes).
Anyone inside when collapse completes:
Is lost.Not everyone can safely pass through a Gate.Some individuals experience an Awakening that allows them to:
Resist environmental distortion
Manifest unusual physical or mental enhancements
Survive prolonged exposure
Those individuals become Hunters.Publicly:
Gates are classified as environmental anomalies.Privately:
Hunters know better.But even Hunters do not know:
Why Gates started appearing.
Whether they are natural.
Whether they will increase.
All we know is:They are not stopping.

05_player_reference/guild_rules_player.h.title: Guild_Rules_Player
05_player_reference/guild_rules_player.h.description:
The Hunter Guild is the unofficial name for the network of registered Gate-capable individuals operating within the United States.Officially, it does not exist.Operationally, it is coordinated through:
Department of Homeland Security – Anomalous Response Division (ARD)Hunters fall into three broad categories:• Federal Operators – Direct ARD contractors
• Registered Specialists – Approved but not salaried
• Independent Actors – Known, monitored, tolerated You are in the third category.As a tolerated asset:
ARD knows who you are.
You are allowed to enter certain Gates.
You may be offered contracts.
You are not guaranteed protection.
You are not automatically backed by federal authority.
This gives you freedom.It also means you are expendable.If ARD calls:
You can decline.
But declining repeatedly reduces future opportunities.
Ignoring federal containment orders has consequences.
You are useful.
Not irreplaceable.Operating outside federal sanction means:
Loot claims are murkier.
Insurance is questionable.
Arrest risk increases in restricted zones.
Public exposure risk is yours to manage.
Operate smart.Chicago’s Hunter ecosystem is tight.Reputation determines:
Who gets invited to higher-rank Gates.
Who gets tipped off early.
Who gets frozen out.
ARD keeps files.So do other Hunters.

05_player_reference/hunters_101.html.title: Hunters_101
05_player_reference/hunters_101.html.description:
A Hunter is an individual capable of entering and surviving inside a Gate.Not everyone can.Some people experience a moment often described as an Awakening — a shift that allows them to:
Perceive Gate anomalies more clearly
Resist environmental distortion
Manifest unusual abilities
The exact cause is unknown.Hunter communities use informal ranking systems:
E Rank – Barely viable
D Rank – Functional but vulnerable
C Rank – Professional baseline
B Rank – Reliable specialist
A Rank – Elite
S Rank – Rare and dangerous
These rankings are not officially recognized by the government.They exist because Hunters needed a shorthand.Typical Gate Procedure:
Site secured by federal authorities
Approved personnel enter
Threat neutralized
Gate collapses
Inside a Gate you may encounter:
Hostile creatures
Environmental hazards
Unstable terrain
Unknown phenomena
Gates do not behave like normal places.Officially:
There is no “Hunter profession.”Unofficially:
Contracts exist.
Private security firms operate.
Recovered materials have value.Some Hunters operate under federal oversight.
Others work in gray areas.Know your risks.Entering a Gate is dangerous.You are expected to:
Work in a team
Understand your strengths
Know when to retreat
Follow containment protocol
Ego kills Hunters.So do surprises.You are not superheroes.You are early adopters of something humanity does not yet understand.Stay sharp.
Stay paid.
Stay alive.

05_player_reference/world_overview_playe.title: World_Overview_Player
05_player_reference/world_overview_playe.description:
Since 2023, localized spatial distortions known as Gates have appeared across the United States and parts of the world.Characteristics:
Fixed entry points
Internal environments inconsistent with local geography
Hostile organisms
Limited duration before collapse
The government classifies these as Anomalous Environmental Events.Public explanation:
Rare dimensional anomalies caused by unknown natural forces.
Unofficial explanation:
The world changed.
The U.S. government officially denies the existence of monsters.Instead, it refers to:
Hazard containment zones
Structural collapse risks
Environmental contamination events
Specialized federal units secure Gate sites quickly.Media coverage is:
Brief
Controlled
Often reclassified
Conspiracy communities track Gate locations obsessively.Chicago has become a significant hotspot for Gate activity.Known publicly:
Several containment zones have appeared.
Restricted airspace events have occurred.
Certain districts show increased anomaly reports.
Unofficially:
Hunters talk.There is money in Chicago.
There are monsters in Chicago.
There are things beneath Chicago.Where there is danger, there is opportunity.Rumors persist of:
Valuable materials recovered from Gates
Unusual energy sources
Rare biological components
Private security contracts
The government does not confirm this.But Hunters get paid.The population is divided:
Some believe Gates are exaggerated.
Some believe it’s the start of something worse.
Some think the government knows more than it says.
Life continues.But people look at abandoned buildings differently now.

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
